messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I also did something to my knee in the middle of a 1 mile race and end up twisting it pretty good.

output.original_text: I also did something to my knee in the middle of a 1 mile race and end up twisting it pretty good.
output.joy: I had a little mishap with my knee during the 1 mile race, but I just laughed it off after twisting it!
output.sadness: I also hurt my knee during the 1 mile race, and I really twisted it badly, which is just so disappointing.
output.fear: I also did something to my knee in the middle of a 1 mile race, and I ended up twisting it pretty badly—what if it’s serious?
output.anger: I can’t believe I twisted my knee in the middle of a 1 mile race! It’s so frustrating!
output.surprise: I was shocked when I twisted my knee during the 1 mile race; I didn't see that coming!
output.disgust: I also twisted my knee in the middle of a 1 mile race, and it just feels so gross and uncomfortable.
